description: The settings window: the app's IPC commands plus event listening. `autostart:default` is deliberately absent -- autostart is applied entirely on the Rust side (settings.rs), the frontend never invokes the plugin -- and `core:default`'s ~40 commands are narrowed to the event family (listen/unlisten for settings://* events) plus the window calls the custom title bar needs: drag, minimize, maximize, close and reading the maximized state.
